This course will introduce the students to (i) Elements of Programming (variables,
 assignments, built-in data types, conditionals, loops, arrays, input-output processing; (ii) Functions and
 Modules; (iii) Object-Oriented programming; and (iv) basic algorithms and data structures (data frames,
 dictionary, list, tuples, etc) for sorting and searching. This course will also introduce the students to a
 collection of open-source tools that are required to analyse data and solve data science problems including
 pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib, and seaborn.
